# `pos` commands

## `pos refund`

Return selected POS receipt lines, or items without a receipt. Posts a credit memo and a customer refund atomically; store_credit leaves the memo open for a named customer and refuses the shared walk-in. Receipt returns preserve captured price, tax and stock cost and cannot exceed sold quantities less active returns. No-receipt returns use current or entered prices and current average inventory value (purchase cost when no positive stock exists). Cash and original-method refunds leave the register refund bank account; card references are recorded, not sent to a processor. A corrected receipt needs a bookkeeper credit memo. Use dry_run to preview, then expected_total to guard the amount. operation_key never expires: retry the same request after a lost answer. Requires pos.refund; this also authorizes no-receipt prices.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | pos.refund |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.refund` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos refund --operation-key counter-return-1 --pos-register Main --lines '[{"item":"Pipe Sealant","quantity":"1"}]' --settlement cash --dry-run --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos refund", "input": {"operation_key": "counter-return-1", "pos_register": "Main", "lines": [{"item": "Pipe Sealant", "quantity": "1"}], "settlement": "cash"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.refund`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |
